title: The Five Computational Thinking Skills
description: Decomposition, pattern recognition, abstraction, algorithm design, debugging -- with a club example for each.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club

educational.audience: Mentors naming what students are doing

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a moment in a coding project, the learner identifies which of the five computational thinking skills is being used.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Click any skill for what it means and a coding club example
pedagogical.assessment: Name the skill a student is using at a given moment in a project.
